cards.ex: The problem boils down to a lack of funding.
cards.exUz: Muammo mablag' yetishmasligiga qaytib keladi.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy sabab yoki nuqtaga qisqartirish, mohiyatga kelish.

cards.ex: Her interest in art sprang from a visit to the Louvre.
cards.exUz: Uning san'atga qiziqishi Luvrga tashrifdan kelib chiqqan.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirning manbai, sababi yoki boshlanishi bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Violence begets violence.
cards.exUz: Zo'ravonlik zo'ravonlikni keltirib chiqaradi.
cards.uzDef: Natija yoki oqibat keltirib chiqarmoq.

cards.ex: He succeeded by virtue of hard work.
cards.exUz: U qattiq mehnat sababli muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirning ta'siri yoki natijasi sababli.

cards.ex: That kind of behaviour is a recipe for disaster.
cards.exUz: Bunday xatti-harakat falokat uchun retseptdir.
cards.uzDef: Biron-bir natijaga olib keladigan aniq yo'l yoki usul.

cards.ex: He invested with a view to making a profit.
cards.exUz: U foyda olish maqsadi bilan investitsiya qildi.
cards.uzDef: Biron-bir narsaga erishish maqsadida.

cards.ex: The trial's outcome hinges on this piece of evidence.
cards.exUz: Sud jarayonining natijasi shu dalilga bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirning natijasi nimagadir bog'liq bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Poverty is a breeding ground for crime.
cards.exUz: Qashshoqlik jinoyatchilik uchun o'choqdir.
cards.uzDef: Biron-bir narsaning rivojlanishi uchun qulay sharoit.

cards.ex: In light of recent events, we've decided to postpone the meeting.
cards.exUz: So'nggi voqealarni hisobga olgan holda, biz yig'ilishni keyinga qoldirishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni hisobga olgan holda.

cards.ex: Lack of communication is often the root of many problems.
cards.exUz: Aloqa yetishmasligi ko'pincha ko'p muammolarning ildizidir.
cards.uzDef: Biron-bir narsaning asosiy sababi.

cards.ex: The alarm triggered a full evacuation of the building.
cards.exUz: Signal bino ichidagi hamma odamni evakuatsiya qilishga sabab bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biron-bir narsaning boshlanishiga sabab bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: New technologies are paving the way for medical breakthroughs.
cards.exUz: Yangi texnologiyalar tibbiy yutuqlar uchun yo'l ochmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda biron-bir narsaning sodir bo'lishiga imkoniyat yaratmoq.

cards.ex: I didn't do it on purpose, it was an accident!
cards.exUz: Men buni atayin qilmadim, bu tasodif edi!
cards.uzDef: Oldindan o'ylab, maqsad bilan qilingan ish.

cards.ex: It's important to identify the underlying cause of the problem.
cards.exUz: Muammoning asosiy sababini aniqlash muhim.
cards.uzDef: Biror hodisaning yashirin yoki asosiy sababi.

cards.ex: This tool is old, but it still serves a purpose.
cards.exUz: Bu asbob eski, lekin u hali ham maqsadga xizmat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Biron-bir foydali yoki zarur vazifani bajarmoq.

cards.ex: The concert was held in aid of cancer research.
cards.exUz: Konsert saraton tadqiqotlariga yordam berish uchun o'tkazildi.
cards.uzDef: Biron-bir maqsadga erishishga yordam berish.

cards.ex: The old building was demolished to make way for a new skyscraper.
cards.exUz: Eski bino yangi osmono'par bino uchun yo'l berish uchun buzib tashlandi.
cards.uzDef: Biron-bir narsaga joy bo'shatish yoki yo'l berish.

cards.ex: The team's success is down to hard work and dedication.
cards.exUz: Jamoaning muvaffaqiyati qattiq mehnat va fidoyilikka bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Biron-bir narsaning sababi yoki mas'uliyati bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The project failed for want of funding.
cards.exUz: Loyiha mablag' yo'qligi sababli amalga oshmadi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirning yetishmasligi yoki yo'qligi sababli.

cards.ex: For him, money is just a means to an end.
cards.exUz: U uchun pul shunchaki maqsadga erishish vositasi.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun foydalaniladigan usul, lekin u o'zi uchun ahamiyatli emas.

cards.ex: The rising crime rate was the impetus for new security measures.
cards.exUz: Jinoyatchilik darajasining oshishi yangi xavfsizlik choralariga turtki bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biron-bir harakat yoki o'zgarish uchun sabab bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The closure of the factory had a ripple effect on the whole town.
cards.exUz: Fabrikaning yopilishi butun shahar bo'ylab to'lqin effektiga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Bir harakatning keng tarqalgan oqibatlari.

cards.ex: One of the side effects of the medication is drowsiness.
cards.exUz: Dori-darmonlarning yon ta'sirlaridan biri - uyquchanlik.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan, qo'shimcha natija.

cards.ex: We're trying to solve the problem by way of compromise.
cards.exUz: Biz muammoni murosaga kelish orqali hal qilishga harakat qilyapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Biron-bir narsaga erishish usuli sifatida.

cards.ex: I studied hard in hopes that I would pass the exam.
cards.exUz: Men imtihondan o'tish umidida qattiq o'qidim.
cards.uzDef: Biron-bir narsa sodir bo'lishiga umid qilib.

cards.ex: She was instrumental in the success of the project.
cards.exUz: U loyihaning muvaffaqiyatida muhim rol o'ynadi.
cards.uzDef: Biron-bir ishning amalga oshishida muhim rol o'ynamoq.

cards.ex: He visited her on the pretext of needing some documents.
cards.exUz: U unga ba'zi hujjatlar kerakligi bahonasi bilan tashrif buyurdi.
cards.uzDef: Yashirin asl sababni yashirish uchun foydalaniladigan soxta sabab.

cards.ex: The company issued a statement in response to the allegations.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya ayblovlarga javoban bayonot berdi.
cards.uzDef: Biron-bir narsaga javob sifatida.

cards.ex: We need to get to the bottom of why this keeps happening.
cards.exUz: Nega bu doimiy ravishda sodir bo'layotganining tubiga yetishimiz kerak.
cards.term: to get to the bottom of
cards.uzDef: Muammoning haqiqiy sababini aniqlash.

cards.ex: I'm doing this for the sake of my family.
cards.exUz: Men buni oilam uchun qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Biron-bir narsani himoya qilish yoki yaxshilash uchun.
